## Oze
The startup turns sales and expense data into credit scores that banks can use to issue collateral-free loans, while also licensing its lending management software to financial institutions.

## Rigo
It is a financial infrastructure startup focused on the healthcare industry. It offers collateral-free loans and insurance. It claims to have disbursed more than [₦10 billion](https://vc4a.com/ventures/rigo-incorporated/?lang=fr) in loans since 2019.

## Tradevu
Tradevu is a fintech providing financial services tailored to businesses operating across the energy, manufacturing, minerals, and agriculture sectors. The company offers a suite of solutions, including business banking, payments, and trade finance, serving more than 200 businesses across four countries.

Tradevu helps businesses manage operations and access working capital more efficiently.
